value.rationale: The three-path bicyclic network with two equal short routes and one adjustable route is a naturally motivated interference model. For every path length, the exact 12-periodic criterion resolves a physically nontrivial perfect-capture question and gives the precise surviving amplitude; this creates a useful analytical boundary between coherent trapping and perfect transport, not a tiny gain or arbitrary finite table. Scope is restricted to ideal adjacency hopping and asymptotic capture.
